# CRDC Social Media Posts

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(targets)
library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(marginaleffects)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggridges)
library(duckdb)
library(knitr)


```

 ## Read Data
```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Connect to database

# Load target data
```

## Post 1: State and National Totals


```{r}
#| label: calc_nat_totals
#| message: false
#| warning: false


dist_ref_arr <- crdc %>%
  group_by(YEAR,LEA_STATE, LEAID, RACE, SEX) %>%
  summarize(ARRESTS = sum(ARRESTS),
            REFERRALS = sum(REFERRALS),
            stu_enroll = sum(stu_enroll),
            jj_count = sum(JJ == "Yes")) |>
  mutate(arrest_rate = ARRESTS / (stu_enroll / 1000),
         referral_rate = REFERRALS / (stu_enroll / 1000)) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, LEA_STATE, LEAID) |>
  mutate(total_enroll = sum(stu_enroll[RACE != "TOTAL" &
                                         SEX != "TOTAL"]))

state_map <- tigris::states(cb  = TRUE, resolution = "20m") |> tigris::shift_geometry()

dist_ref_arr |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(RACE == "TOTAL" & SEX == "TOTAL") |>
    summarize(
        all_lea_count = n_distinct(LEAID),
        lea_any_arr = n_distinct(LEAID[ARRESTS >0]),
        enrollment = sum(stu_enroll),
        arrests = sum(ARRESTS),
        referrals = sum(REFERRALS)) -> nat_totals

nat_arrest_rate <- nat_totals$referrals / (nat_totals$enrollment / 1000)
nat_referral_rate <- nat_totals$arrests / (nat_totals$enrollment / 1000)
nat_totals
```



```{r}
#| label: calc_state_totals
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dist_ref_arr |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(RACE == "TOTAL" & SEX == "TOTAL") |>
    group_by(LEA_STATE) |>
    summarize(
        all_lea_count = n_distinct(LEAID),
        lea_any_arr = n_distinct(LEAID[ARRESTS >0]),
        enrollment = sum(stu_enroll),
        arrests = sum(ARRESTS),
        referrals = sum(REFERRALS)) |>
    mutate(arrest_rate = arrests / (enrollment / 1000)) |>
    mutate(arrest_nnh = enrollment / arrests) -> state_totals

state_map2 <- inner_join(state_map, state_totals, by = join_by(STUSPS == LEA_STATE))
```


```{r}
#| label: arrest_chloropleth
#| message: false
#| warning: false

p1 <- ggplot(data = state_map2, aes(fill = arrests)) +
  geom_sf() +
  label_states(state_map2, "arrests", label_fn = civilytics::pretty_count,
              fill = "white", size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_distiller("Arrests", palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Students arrested at school by state", subtitle = "34,846 school-based arrests in 2021-22", caption = "Source: U.S. Department of Education Civil Rights Data Collection, 2021-22") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    #plot.margin = rep(unit(6, "pt"), 4),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAF7"),
        legend.position.inside = c(0.9, 0.32),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))


plot(civilytics::add_logo(p1, civilytics::make_logo_grob(), margin_param = -12))


```

## Post 2: Trends

```{r}
#| label: national_trend
#| message: false
#| warning: false

#combined_data <- targets::tar_read(combined_model_data)

# Unfiltered CRDC without requiring join to CCD
combined_data <- bind_rows(targets::tar_read(full_crdc_data_y2122),
                            targets::tar_read(full_crdc_data_y1718),
                            targets::tar_read(full_crdc_data_y1516))


year_summary <- combined_data |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  filter(RACE == "TOTAL" & SEX == "TOTAL") |>
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_schools = n_distinct(COMBOKEY),
    n_districts = n_distinct(LEAID),
    total_enrollment = sum(stu_enroll, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_arrests = sum(ARRESTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_referrals = sum(REFERRALS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p1 <- ggplot(year_summary, aes(x = YEAR, y = total_arrests)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(group = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pretty_count(total_arrests)), nudge_x = 0.15) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), labels = scales::comma,
                  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "CRDC Wave", y = "CRDC Arrests",
  title = "Arrest trends across CRDC waves",
  subtitle = "Total arrests nationally.",
  caption = "Source: U.S. Department of Education Civil Rights Data Collection, 2021-22, 2017-18, and 2015-16") +
  civilytics::theme_civilytics(font_size =14)

plot(civilytics::add_logo(p1, civilytics::make_logo_grob(), margin_param = -12))
```


```{r}
#| label: national_arrest_rate_trend
#| message: false
#| warning: false


p1 <- ggplot(year_summary, aes(x = YEAR, y = total_arrests/(total_enrollment/1000))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(group = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(total_arrests/(total_enrollment/1000), digits = 2), " arrests per \n1,000 students")), nudge_x = 0.15, vjust = 0, hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "CRDC Wave", y = "CRDC Arrests per 1,000", title = "Arrest rate trends across CRDC waves",
  caption = "Source: U.S. Department of Education Civil Rights Data Collection, 2021-22, 2017-18, and 2015-16") +
  civilytics::theme_civilytics(font_size =14)

plot(civilytics::add_logo(p1, civilytics::make_logo_grob(), margin_param = -12))


```


```{r}
#| label: select_state_arrest_trend
#| message: false
#| warning: false

state_year_summary <- combined_data |>
  group_by(LEA_STATE, YEAR) |>
  filter(RACE == "TOTAL" & SEX == "TOTAL") |>
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_schools = n_distinct(COMBOKEY),
    n_districts = n_distinct(LEAID),
    total_enrollment = sum(stu_enroll, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_arrests = sum(ARRESTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_referrals = sum(REFERRALS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


p1 <- ggplot(state_year_summary |> filter(LEA_STATE %in% c("CA", "KS")),
    aes(x = YEAR, y = total_arrests, group = LEA_STATE)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = LEA_STATE)) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.1, y = 2450, label = "Kansas") +
    annotate("text", x = 3.1, y = 1500, label = "California") +

   geom_text(aes(label = pretty_count(total_arrests)), nudge_y = 100, nudge_x = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), labels = scales::comma,
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    guides(linetype = guide_none()) +
  labs(x = "CRDC Wave", y = "CRDC Arrests",
caption = "Source: U.S. Department of Education Civil Rights Data Collection, 2021-22, 2017-18, and 2015-16",
  title = "Comparing state arrest rate trends across CRDC waves", subtitle = "Kansas and California") +
  civilytics::theme_civilytics(font_size =14)

plot(civilytics::add_logo(p1, civilytics::make_logo_grob(), margin_param = -12))


```

### Looking into Kansas

```{r}
#| label: kansas_lea
#| message: false
#| warning: false

combined_data |>
    group_by(LEA_STATE, LEAID, YEAR) |>
    filter(RACE == "TOTAL" & SEX == "TOTAL") |>
    summarize(
        total_enrollment = sum(stu_enroll, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_arrests = sum(ARRESTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_referrals = sum(REFERRALS, na.rm = TRUE),
    ) -> lea_data

lea_data |> filter(YEAR == "21-22" & LEA_STATE == "KS") |>
    arrange(desc(total_arrests)) |>
    inner_join(tydata |> select(YEAR, LEAID, LEA_NAME) |> distinct_all(),
    by = join_by(YEAR, LEAID)) |>
        select(LEA_STATE, YEAR, LEAID, LEA_NAME, everything())



```


## Districts


```{r}
#| label: national_lea_table
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(flextable)

img_path <- "export/figures/socialmedia-national_lea_table.png"

table_data <- lea_data |>
  inner_join(tydata |> select(YEAR, LEAID, LEA_NAME) |> distinct_all(),
    by = join_by(YEAR, LEAID)) |>
  mutate(YEAR = dplyr::recode_values(YEAR,
    "21-22" ~ "2021_22",
    "15-16" ~ "2015_16",
    "17-18" ~ "2017_18")) |>
  group_by(LEAID) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(LEA_STATE, LEAID, LEA_NAME),
    values_from = c(total_enrollment, total_arrests), names_from = YEAR) |>
  mutate(arrest_rate_2021_22 = total_arrests_2021_22 / (total_enrollment_2021_22 / 1000)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_arrests_2021_22)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(LEA_STATE, LEA_NAME, total_enrollment_2021_22,
    total_arrests_2021_22, arrest_rate_2021_22,
    total_arrests_2015_16, total_arrests_2017_18) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  mutate(
    LEA_NAME                 = stringr::str_to_title(LEA_NAME),
    total_enrollment_2021_22 = scales::comma(total_enrollment_2021_22, accuracy = 1),
    total_arrests_2021_22    = scales::comma(total_arrests_2021_22, accuracy = 1),
    arrest_rate_2021_22      = scales::comma(arrest_rate_2021_22, accuracy = 0.1),
    total_arrests_2015_16    = scales::comma(total_arrests_2015_16, accuracy = 1),
    total_arrests_2017_18    = scales::comma(total_arrests_2017_18, accuracy = 1)
  )

header_bg <- "#2c3e50"
header_fg <- "white"
alt_bg    <- "#f0f0eb"

ft <- flextable(table_data) |>
  set_header_labels(
    LEA_STATE                = "State",
    LEA_NAME                 = "District",
    total_enrollment_2021_22 = "Enrollment\n(2021-22)",
    total_arrests_2021_22    = "Arrests\n(2021-22)",
    arrest_rate_2021_22      = "Arrest Rate\n(per 1,000)",
    total_arrests_2015_16    = "Arrests\n(2015-16)",
    total_arrests_2017_18    = "Arrests\n(2017-18)"
  ) |>
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "", "", "", "Historical Arrests"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 3),
    top       = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_header_lines("Top 20 School Districts by Student Arrests — CRDC 2021-22") |>
  bg(bg = header_bg, part = "header") |>
  color(color = header_fg, part = "header") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  fontsize(i = 1, size = 14, part = "header") |>
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "body") |>
  bg(i = seq(2, 20, 2), bg = alt_bg, part = "body") |>
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") |>
  align(j = c("LEA_STATE", "LEA_NAME"), align = "left",  part = "body") |>
  align(j = c("total_enrollment_2021_22", "total_arrests_2021_22",
              "arrest_rate_2021_22", "total_arrests_2015_16",
              "total_arrests_2017_18"), align = "right", part = "body") |>
  align(part = "header", align = "center") |>
  width(j = "LEA_STATE",                width = 0.55) |>
  width(j = "LEA_NAME",                 width = 2.4)  |>
  width(j = "total_enrollment_2021_22", width = 1.1)  |>
  width(j = "total_arrests_2021_22",    width = 1.0)  |>
  width(j = "arrest_rate_2021_22",      width = 1.05) |>
  width(j = "total_arrests_2015_16",    width = 1.0)  |>
  width(j = "total_arrests_2017_18",    width = 1.0)  |>
  border_outer(part = "all",  border = officer::fp_border(color = "#888888", width = 1)) |>
  border_inner_h(part = "body", border = officer::fp_border(color = "#cccccc", width = 0.5)) |>
  add_footer_lines("Source: U.S. Department of Education Civil Rights Data Collection") |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer") |>
  color(color = "#555555", part = "footer") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")

# Export high-res PNG using ragg (no browser/Chrome dependency)
{
  dims <- flextable_dim(ft)
  ragg::agg_png(img_path,
    width   = dims$width,
    height  = dims$height,
    units   = "in",
    res     = 300,
    scaling = 1
  )
  plot(ft)
  dev.off()
}

# Embed in rendered document
knitr::include_graphics(img_path)
```
